items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Some wonderful guys, like Dan Burney, like Scoops Kerry, great musicians.

ctx.x: Then they took all that money and went to Mexico and started getting in the textiles. They‟re still in textile industry down there and their mother went down there with them. My mother was their mother‟s friend so my mother used to always go to Mexico because that was their mother‟s [unintelligible]. So it was that kind of relationship that we had but that was all out of that… Eddie Cole‟s was a giant. Dexter Travis was… well he couldn‟t even get into our society [laughter]. We kid him about that to this very…
